sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.744 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Basta, arising out of Baliapal P.S. Case No.289 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 498- A/323/294/341/307/376/325/506/34 of IPC.
4.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that petitioner no.1, Sandhyarani Giri in ABLAPL No.2083 of 2025 is the mother-in-law and other two petitioners are the sisters-in-law of the informant.

So far as the petitioners in ABLPAL No.1442 of 2025 are concerned, petitioner no.1,
Laxmikanta Giri is the husband, petitioner no.2, Sudarsana Giri is the father-in-law and petitioner nos.3 to 5, Kamalakanta Giri, Surjyakanta Giri and Chandrakanta Giri respectively are the brothers-in- law of the informant.
It is further submitted that omnibus allegations have been made against the petitioners.
Hence, the petitioners may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
5. Such submission is opposed by the learned counsel for the State.
6. This Court perused the 164 of Cr.P.C. statement of the victim and other materials on record.

Taking note of the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application of petitioner no.1,
Laxmikanta Giri, the husband in ABLAPL No.1442 of 2025 as well as petitioner no.4, Surjyakanta Giri, one of the brothers-in-law of the informant.
7.

So far as petitioner nos.1 to 3, namely, Sandhyarani Giri, Kabita Giri and Mitali Giri respectively in ABLAPL No.2083 of 2025 and petitioner nos.2, 3 & 5, namely, Sudarsana Giri, Kamalakanta Giri and Chandrakanta Giri respectively in ABLAPL No.1442 of 2025 are concerned, they are directed to surrender before the Court below within four weeks hence and in that event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as would be fixed by the learned Court below.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPLs stand disposed of.
9. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Manoj Designation: AR-CUM-SENIOR SECRETARY Sandhyarani Giri vs State Of Odisha & ....
